description: Shared cases for the Algo settings rule set. Python (tests/portfolio/test_settings_rules.py) and OpenStock (test/algo-trader-rules.test.js) both apply each case to the shipped defaults and must agree.

cases.name: risk per trade above cap
cases.error: general.risk_per_trade_pct must be between 0 and 0.02

cases.name: gross above cash floor
cases.error: portfolio.max_gross_pct cannot exceed the configured cash floor

cases.name: entry budgets exceed daily
cases.error: portfolio intraday and swing entry limits cannot exceed the daily entry limit

cases.name: unknown regime engine
cases.error: general.regime_engine must be committee, rule, hmm, or gmm

cases.name: training window too short
cases.error: general.model_training_window must be at least 252

cases.name: strategy above portfolio cap
cases.error: strategies.swing_mean_reversion.max_position_pct must be positive and within the portfolio strategy cap

cases.name: horizon is fixed by catalog
cases.error: Strategy horizon and bar interval are fixed by the catalog

cases.name: sector cap above gross cap
cases.error: portfolio.sector_caps.core_tech must be within the gross exposure cap

cases.name: regime gross cap above gross cap
cases.error: portfolio.regime_gross_caps.trending_up:calm must be within the gross exposure cap

cases.name: regime weight too large
cases.error: strategies.swing_mean_reversion.regime_weights.trending_up must be between 0 and 1.5

cases.name: volatility scale too large
cases.error: general.volatility_risk_scales.calm must be between 0 and 1.5

cases.name: llm confidence out of range
cases.error: strategies.swing_llm_driven.minimum_confidence must be an integer between 0 and 100

cases.name: net short percent above one
cases.error: portfolio.max_net_short_pct must be between 0 and 1

cases.name: fractional position count
cases.error: strategies.swing_momentum.max_positions must be a non-negative integer

cases.name: zero name cap
cases.error: portfolio.max_name_pct must be positive

cases.name: stop above half
cases.error: strategies.swing_momentum stop settings must be between 0 and 0.5

cases.name: quote windows inverted
cases.error: execution.quote_stale_seconds cannot exceed execution.extended_quote_stale_seconds

cases.name: entry band negative
cases.error: execution.entry_limit_band_bps must be between 0 and 100

cases.name: candidate sector cap above gross
cases.error: portfolio.candidate_sector_cap must be positive and within the gross exposure cap

cases.name: cash reserve proxy share above one
cases.error: cash_reserve.max_proxy_pct must be between 0 and 1
